result.summary: The home screen has several layout and content problems: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, two cards in Fastest near you appear identical, and the promo banner text sits awkwardly over the decorative graphic.

issues.description: The third Fastest near you card title is cut off as 'Smash Bros Bu' and the last category chip is only a sliver, so users cannot read the full names.
issues.suggestion: Give cards enough width or allow wrapping/ellipsis with a tooltip, and add peek or scroll padding so the last category chip is fully visible.

issues.description: The first two Fastest near you cards show the same restaurant, image, time, and delivery fee (Green Bowl Poké twice).
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the list so each nearby restaurant appears once, or clearly distinguish different locations/menus if they are meant to be unique.

issues.description: Promo banner body copy overlaps the circular graphic and is cramped against the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add more right padding or constrain the illustration so the offer text stays fully readable.

issues.description: The bottom Popular card is cropped by the tab bar, hiding most of the restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
